adaptations: hand-written case (happy + edge) — no upstream libxslt coverage exists for math:log/math:exp. Exact identities pinned exactly (log(1)=0, exp(0)=1); log(E via math:constant) pins the engine's double noise (1.0000000000000018); log(0) pins -INF and exp(1000) pins INF per IEEE-754 XPath 3.1 semantics; negative log pins NaN. Goldens are engine-verified output of src/math.xsl.
